0./data/nonlinearity_map/description: Ground-truth coefficient of nonlinearity beta = 1 + (B/A)/2. Recover B/A as 2 * (beta - 1).

shared.attr_description: Fullwave 2 nonlinear full-wave simulation of transabdominal liver imaging on an anthropomorphic numerical phantom segmented from Visible Human cryosections. Full synthetic aperture acquisition on a simulated C5-2v curvilinear array (128 elements, 49.57 mm radius, 0.508 mm pitch, 3.7 MHz). Channel data is paired with the ground-truth material maps that generated it.
